feat(tools)!: component library store and project persistence

The .camproj file now saves the document tool component table
(components) and each tool's component stack (assembly). The loader
reads the table and every stack before any world write, checks that each
link names a row and that each stack resolves, and lands them through
table_set and set_assembly in place of the clear-on-open. The derived
tool record and body stay as the file states them, so an open never
shifts a posted program.

A document component can link to a user library copy (library_ref: the
library id and an FNV-1a content hash). The user component library is
camcraft-components/1 in CAMCRAFT_COMPONENTS, else
<data dir>/camcraft/components/components.camcomponents, read all or
nothing and saved through a temp file and a rename. The holder library
and the starter catalog are read-only built-in components. sync_status
compares a row with its library copy and never applies it;
SyncDocumentComponent pulls the copy in and derives every user tool
again in one undo step.

The .camtools export of components is left on #3645.

BREAKING CHANGE: the project file steps to v84. A v83 build refuses the
files that this build writes; v83 and older files open unchanged.

Refs #3645

feat(ui): tool library window edits user holders and component stacks

#3898 (U7 of #3663), the UI scope of #3648, on the component table of
#4201 and the user library of #4233:

- "My library" is a third source of the tools list: the built-in and
  user library components by group, a name filter, "Show compatible
  parts" (compatible_parents / compatible_children), and the document's
  component table with each row's library status and users.
- A component editor (name, insert code, a holder's gauge length) lands
  one undoable EditDocumentComponent; every tool built from the
  component follows in the same undo step. Sync from library, Save to
  My library and Delete from document stand beside it.
- A built-in holder copies as a user holder; the Holders page lists the
  document's user holders.
- The Tool tab's assembly group shows the tool's component stack:
  "Add component" offers only the parts that fit, Apply stack is one
  SetToolAssembly, "Detach to standalone tool" clears the stack.
- app re-exports component_fit, frame, insert_iso1832, insert_seat and
  tool_assembly::Mount for the UI.

docs/decisions/3898-tool-library-components.md.

fix(ui): component copies keep the whole row; caches move into State

Review of PR #4271 (mkinney):
- "Copy as user component" of a document row copies the whole row
  (the #3646 cutter facts and running data too) under the new user id,
  without the library link, through UpsertDocumentComponent::with_row.
- The component pages' caches (rows with status and users, the
  compatible set, the stack's Add offer) move from page thread-locals
  into State (state_component_views). The table and the stacks are read
  once for each document version; a set builds again only when that
  read differs, the library read changes, or the filter or the stack
  draft changes. The stack group no longer clones the table each frame.
- New tests: the copy keeps its facts and running data (undo, redo);
  "Add to document" by a click is one undo step with its link; the
  caches build on a changed input only (still frame, unrelated document
  change, filter, draft, table).

Refs #3898
